products.name: Tijara Business Account
products.summary: A Sharia-compliant current account for small and medium-sized businesses.
features: Sharia-compliant current account (no interest paid or charged)
Payroll through the Wage Protection System (WPS)
Free local transfers and a business debit card
Full online and mobile banking, including approvals by multiple signatories
Dedicated relationship manager for businesses with turnover above QAR 3 million
limitations: No profit is paid on the account balance
Monthly fee if the average balance falls below the minimum
Cheque book limited to 50 cheques per month
eligibility: Business registered in Qatar with a valid Commercial Registration
products.fees: No monthly fee with an average balance of QAR 50,000 or more; otherwise QAR 100 per month.

products.name: Islamic Receivables Finance
products.summary: Short-term Sharia-compliant financing that releases cash tied up in unpaid invoices.
features: Advance of up to 80% of the value of approved invoices
Based on Murabaha: a fixed profit amount agreed upfront, with no compounding
Terms of 30 to 120 days to match customers' payment terms
Revolving limit: as invoices are paid, the limit becomes available again
limitations: Only invoices issued to approved, creditworthy corporate or government customers
Requires 2 years of audited financial statements
Requires a Tijara Business Account with Pearl Coast Bank
Does not fund long-term investments such as new premises or equipment
eligibility: Annual turnover of at least QAR 2 million
products.fees: Profit rate agreed per transaction; one-off arrangement fee of 0.5% of the approved limit.

products.name: Business Flex Overdraft
products.summary: A conventional revolving overdraft for day-to-day working capital.
features: Limit of up to QAR 500,000 on a business current account
Interest charged only on the amount actually used
Use any time without applying again
limitations: Interest-based, so not Sharia-compliant
Variable interest rate that can rise with market rates
Requires a personal guarantee from the business owner
Reviewed every year and can be reduced or withdrawn
eligibility: Business current account held with Pearl Coast Bank
products.fees: Variable interest on the amount used; annual renewal fee of 0.5% of the limit.

products.name: Ijara Equipment Finance
products.summary: Sharia-compliant lease-to-own financing for business equipment.
features: Finances up to QAR 3 million of new equipment
Ijara (lease-to-own): the bank buys the equipment and leases it to the business
Ownership passes to the business at the end of the lease
Fixed monthly rentals over 3 to 5 years
limitations: Covers equipment only, not renovation, fit-out or working capital
The bank owns the equipment until the final payment
Takaful (Islamic insurance) on the equipment is required
Down payment of 20% of the equipment cost
products.fees: Rental rate agreed at signing; arrangement fee of 1% of the financed amount.

products.name: Everyday Salary Account
products.summary: A personal current account for salaried employees, with low-cost transfers abroad.
features: 4 free international transfers per month to over 30 countries
Preferential exchange rates on transfers abroad
Free debit card and mobile banking
Transfers can be scheduled to repeat every month
limitations: Salary must be paid into the account
Conventional account, not Sharia-compliant
Transfers after the 4 free ones cost QAR 15 each
eligibility: Monthly salary of at least QAR 5,000
products.fees: No monthly fee while the salary is paid in; otherwise QAR 25 per month.

products.name: Personal Consolidation Loan
products.summary: A fixed-rate personal loan to combine and pay off existing debts, including overseas debts.
features: Borrow up to QAR 200,000 at a fixed interest rate
Repay over 12 to 48 months with equal monthly instalments
Can be used to pay off credit cards and loans in Qatar or abroad
One monthly payment instead of several
limitations: Interest-based, so not Sharia-compliant
Requires an Everyday Salary Account with the salary paid in
Monthly repayments cannot exceed 50% of salary
Early settlement fee of 1% of the remaining balance
eligibility: At least 6 months with the current employer
Monthly salary of at least QAR 5,000
products.fees: Fixed interest rate agreed at signing; processing fee of 1% of the loan (maximum QAR 1,000).

products.name: Wakala Term Deposit
products.summary: A low-risk Sharia-compliant deposit that earns an expected profit over a fixed term.
features: Wakala: the bank invests the money as an agent in low-risk Sharia-compliant assets
Terms of 3, 6 or 12 months
Expected profit rate shown before opening; profit paid at maturity
Several deposits with different terms can be opened, so money becomes available at different times
limitations: The profit rate is expected, not guaranteed
Money is locked in for the chosen term
Withdrawing early returns the original amount but no profit
products.fees: No fees; the bank's agency fee is already reflected in the expected profit rate.

products.name: Global Currency Account
products.summary: A Sharia-compliant account that holds QAR, USD, GBP and EUR in one place.
features: Hold and switch between QAR, USD, GBP and EUR
Preferential exchange rates, including for regular monthly conversions
Pay international fees, such as university tuition, directly in the foreign currency
Multi-currency debit card for spending abroad
limitations: No profit is paid on balances
The QAR value of GBP and EUR balances changes with exchange rates
Monthly fee if the total balance falls below the minimum
products.fees: No monthly fee with a combined balance of QAR 10,000 or more; otherwise QAR 50 per month.

products.name: Growth Equity Fund
products.summary: An investment fund in global company shares, aiming for long-term growth.
features: Invests in a broad mix of global company shares
Potential for higher returns over the long term
Start with a lump sum or monthly amounts from QAR 1,000
Value can be checked daily in the mobile app
limitations: Capital is at risk: the value can fall and investors can get back less than they put in
Recommended minimum holding period of 5 years
Not Sharia-compliant: the fund holds conventional banks and other non-compliant companies
Selling in the first year costs an extra 1%
products.fees: 2% entry fee and 1.5% annual management fee.
